values.summary: Execute the smallest proving validation DAG.

lanes.proof_role: Exact child terminal denominator, cross-child metadata parity, provider-status truth, privacy, and integrated closeout checks
lanes.defer_reason: Deferred until the issue is bound, all declared dependencies pass, and the owned validator or proof target is implemented; missing target, zero tests, or any failure blocks publication.

lanes.proof_role: Reject malformed tracked changes before exact-head review.
lanes.defer_reason: Run after the issue has a bounded candidate diff.

values.failure_policy: Fail closed on dependency, ownership, authority, privacy, validation, exact-revision, or review drift; preserve evidence and route separate defects without widening the issue.
